purpose: Assemble the 167-record exclusive-equipment consumer payload using the shared Stage 3-1 list/detail schema and frozen Stage 2 semantics, without inventing hero ownership or release chronology.

listPolicy.nameKr: Copy only Stage 3-2 VERIFIED_REFERENCE_MATCH nameKr. REVIEW candidates must not leak; unresolved nameKr stays null.
listPolicy.icon: Must copy Stage 3-2 VERIFIED_DIRECT icon for all 167 records.
listPolicy.sorting: Sort by groupOrder asc, subtypeOrder asc, sortIndex asc, equipmentId asc. This is deterministic presentation order only and is never claimed as exclusive-equipment release chronology.

detailPolicy.identity: Use equipmentId/nameCn plus Stage 3-2 verified display metadata.
detailPolicy.classification: Copy Stage 2-3 classification and Stage 2-7 equipmentType/label/acquisition metadata exactly.
detailPolicy.stats: Copy Stage 2-4 stats without recalculation; maxLevel remains 50.
detailPolicy.effect: Copy Stage 2-5 max effect data and rich segments exactly; no translation/summary/rewrite.
detailPolicy.restriction: Copy Stage 2-6 mode/generalArmyIds/specialJobIds exactly; retain the existing 0.99 structural-inference status without claiming runtime-direct proof.
detailPolicy.acquisition: Copy Stage 2-7 releaseGroupDate/confidencePercent/classificationBasis exactly. Do not invent dates or chronology.

heroOwnershipBoundary.policy: Stage 3-5 does not derive Hero -> exclusive Equipment ownership. That relation is a separate Hero consumer task. Never infer ownership from name similarity, equipment order, icon naming, or release order.

hardRequirements: all records are acquisitionClass exclusive-equipment and siteTab null
all 167 upstream acquisition rows retain exactly one GetPathList entry with PathType 46
all 167 list records satisfy the shared Stage 3-1 list field contract
all 167 detail records satisfy the shared Stage 3-1 detail block contract
review Korean-name candidates never leak into consumer nameKr
stats/effects/restrictions/acquisition blocks exactly equal their frozen Stage 2 sources
no general/soul-special/unresolved record leaks into the exclusive consumer
no hero ownership relation is generated
reviewAllowed: 128 inherited unresolved Korean names from Stage 3-2
exact exclusive-equipment release chronology is not asserted unless an upstream releaseGroupDate exists
Stage 2-6 runtime equip-check direct proof remains unlocated

completion: The 167 exclusive-equipment records have page-consumable list and detail payloads with frozen semantics and explicit inherited review states, while hero ownership remains intentionally outside this stage.
